name: Take the Bait
oracle_text:
Cast this spell only during combat on an opponent's turn.
Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to you and planeswalkers you control this turn. Untap all attacking creatures and goad them. After this phase, there is an additional combat phase.
blocked_sentences: Cast this spell only during combat on an opponent's turn.
Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to you and planeswalkers you control this turn.

needs.what: a card-level casting restriction on a spell: it may be cast only while the active player is an opponent of its caster AND the game is in the combat phase ('Cast this spell only during combat on an opponent's turn'), checked when the cast is offered -- the same timing-window family as Delirium's 'only during an opponent's turn'
needs.why_existing_wont_do: card_level_rider_keys has cant_cast_first_turns and split_second but no timing window; the `cast_during` / `is_your_turn` condition keys are read inside effects or statics, so an `if` would let the spell be cast on your own main phase and do nothing rather than be uncastable

needs.what: a one-shot, this-turn, combat-only prevention over the permanents a player controls that match a selector ('planeswalkers you control'), matched on the damaged permanent's current characteristics as the damage would be dealt (615.1), alongside the combat_only prevent_damage shield over the player
needs.why_existing_wont_do: prevent_damage with combat_only covers the seat ('you') but not its permanents; prevent_damage_permanent with combat_only shields objects chosen at resolution, so a planeswalker that arrives or changes control later in the turn would be judged by the board the spell saw; prevent_combat_damage is keyed to the dealer, not the recipient
